note: Cases for ORB_NAV_TARGET_UNDECLARED, a final-only rule (rule nav-target-final): a literal navigation target (an href or navigatesTo in a config default or a render-ui payload, a lazy page's links) must match a declared page route (inline page, expects page route, lazy page; :name matches one segment; query, fragment and empty segments ignored). Literal navigate effects belong to std-orb-lint-navigate. Reds: navItems href in app config and trait config; an orbital config href; a rendered href and navigatesTo; a locale-prefixed concat folded through the config defaults; a lazy page link. Controls: declared, param, query, fragment, root and trailing-slash targets, a protocol page, an expects page, a lazy page, an empty prefix, computed paths, external URLs, mailto, anchors, the signIn route, /login, a child (lazy) scope.
